item.description:

  • 発売日: 2017-11-24
  • スコア: 6.779999999999999/10 (28 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 今夜だけでも泊めて下さい
  • 英語名: Kon’ya dake demo Tomete Kudasai

别名

  • 今夜だけでも泊めてください

あらすじ

With nothing else better to do, the protagonist spends every day alternating between home and work like a machine. One day while heading home after doing overtime, he noticed a post on a social network site looking for a place to stay for the night. Even though he thought it thought it was obviously shady, he longed to experience just a little bit of thrill in his life void of stimulation.

item.title: Selfre -Self Friend-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hexenhaus
  • 発売日: 2017-02-24
  • スコア: 7.459999999999999/10 (72 人評価)
  • 日本語名: セルフレ -セルフフレンド-
  • 英語名: Selfre -Self Friend-

别名

  • Serufure

あらすじ

Shinobu is part of the camera club, which is lacking members other than him and the club leader Umi. One day, a close-up selfie focused on the large cleavage was posted on a website he runs. He thought that it looked like that of the honours student Ai, and she unwillingly admitted to taking the picture when he approached her about it. Surprisingly, instead of using it as blackmail, he reprimanded her for taking poor pictures. He offered to capture her beauty and she agreed, having been talked to in such a way for the first time.

item.title: Angenehm Platz -Kleiner Garten Sie Erstellen-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hexenhaus
  • 発売日: 2016-01-29
  • スコア: 6.5/10 (26 人評価)
  • 日本語名: アンゲネームプラッツ-Kleiner Garten Sie Erstellen-
  • 英語名: Angenehm Platz -Kleiner Garten Sie Erstellen-

あらすじ

Protagonist Rio’s childhood friend Yuuna likes cosplay, though she tries to keep it as hidden as possible. One day she makes him cosplay as a girl, forcing a girl’s school uniform and a wig onto him. She even makes him wear some make-up. After that she forces him to go home like that without being found out, under the guise that she wants to proof that it’s the perfect crossdressing cosplay.

  • 英語名: Lautes Alltags -Herrenlose Katze und Teehaus-

あらすじ

Kisaragi was not able to find a job after graduation, so he has been reluctantly helping out his older sister Mutsuki at her café Kirschtorte since spring while continuing his job search. Located near the train station in a residential neighbourhood, it was often visited by students returning home. He did his shift every day with veteran part-timer Himari and osananajimi Sana, and business was generally quite good.

item.title: Koi Suru Kimochi no Hanakotoba
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hexenhaus
  • 発売日: 2014-02-28
  • スコア: 7.209999999999999/10 (29 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 恋する気持ちの花言葉
  • 英語名: Koi Suru Kimochi no Hanakotoba

あらすじ

This is the first title by HexenHaus. Takumi was entrusted with managing the student dormitory that had previously been taken care of by his grandmother. He went to the dormitory with his osananajimi Kana and greeted new residents Nanakusa and Sara. After the busy spring break, he started the new school term with Kana, Sara, and his friend since last year Tsubaki. Due to bad grades, Kana and Tsubaki also ended up living at the dormitory as well. Thus began the awkward house life with his osananajimi, friend, kouhai and senpai, as a new dorm manager.
